sn34.14:1.4: idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ
sn34.14:1.5: kallitakusalo. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti na
sn34.14:1.6: samādhismiṃ samāpattakusalo. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na
sn34.14:1.7: samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca hoti
